findings.title: Joint confidence threshold overwritten
findings.evidence: delta = chi2.ppf(cl, df=2) is immediately followed by delta = 1.0 in both fit functions.
findings.impact: The displayed 68.3% ellipse encloses 39.35% for a two-dimensional Gaussian. A joint 68.3% contour needs delta=2.2977 and axes 1.5158 times larger.
findings.recommendation: Expose delta-chi2/coverage explicitly and retain separate one-parameter errors and joint contours.

findings.title: Hall C time scaling is inverted and applied to every setting
findings.evidence: hallc_stat_loq=sqrt(split/0.5), hallc_stat_hiq=sqrt((1-split)/0.5); cell 8 applies loq to all HMS and SHMS files.
findings.impact: At split=0.2 the notebook multiplies errors by 0.63246 instead of 1.58114 for reduced low-angle exposure relative to the same-total 50:50 baseline. It does not enforce the user's 30-day total budget.
findings.recommendation: Use sqrt(reference_time/allocated_time) from explicit setting-pair exposure records; reject zero exposure and duplicate time allocations.

findings.title: Amplitude correlation fraction used as variance fraction
findings.impact: If the listed 0.4% and 0.2% sources are the intended correlated components, f_corr should be their squared sum divided by total systematic variance. Off-diagonal variance is inflated by about 27.5% for the nominal SoLID input.
findings.recommendation: Define correlated source amplitudes directly or use the squared amplitude fraction consistently; document the intended decomposition.

findings.title: Undefined setting groups prevent a clean sequential run
findings.evidence: data_sets_hms1, data_sets_shms1, data_sets_hms2, data_sets_shms2 are used without assignment; result_11gev_hallc1 and result_11gev_hallc1_all are also used without definition.
findings.impact: Supplying the missing files alone would not make the exported notebook execute top to bottom.
findings.recommendation: Define the setting groups from an explicit schedule and remove dependencies on hidden interactive state.

findings.title: Display recentering overwrites fitted parameter records
findings.evidence: Multiple result['params'] assignments replace the fitted centers; the four-parameter result is replaced by a two-element display vector in cell 23.
findings.impact: Returned params can disagree with fitted, cov_full, chi2, and residuals. Shifted ellipses illustrate precision, not measured best fits.
findings.recommendation: Preserve fitted_params and covariances; store display_center separately, with the shift and purpose recorded.

findings.title: Common systematics stop at dataset boundaries
findings.evidence: Covariance is block diagonal between dataset dictionaries, with one same-sign correlated source inside each block.
findings.impact: Polarimetry or other common sources across HMS/SHMS settings are not represented unless all relevant rows are put into one explicitly shared source block.
findings.recommendation: Represent each physical systematic as a source vector spanning every affected measurement; validate signs and overlap.

findings.title: Hadronic templates supplied, but application and authority need review
findings.evidence: A=(c1*X+c2*Y)*(1+beta_HT/((1-x)^3*Q2)+beta_CSV*x^2); beta applies only where the second coefficient is nonzero.
findings.impact: beta_HT has units GeV^2 and beta_CSV is dimensionless. Both terms multiply the full asymmetry. The coefficient mask is not an explicit dataset-physics label; no priors or bounds are supplied.
findings.recommendation: Retain this exact ansatz as notebook provenance; validate its scientific interpretation and use an explicit apply_hadronic flag before the PAC fit.

findings.title: Derived external constraints treated as independent priors
findings.evidence: Elastic+Cs, the Qweak-derived X constraint, and projected P2 X constraint are separate independent scalar datasets with placeholder x=0.99,Q2=10000.
findings.impact: Independence of the derived Qweak constraint from the elastic+Cs input is not established by the notebook. P2 is a projection, not a measurement.
findings.recommendation: Recover the upstream likelihood/provenance and shared information; do not claim an independently combined world fit until this is resolved.

findings.title: External tables missing and parsers silently skip rows
findings.evidence: 28 Hall C tables, four HRS tables, solid11.dat, and pvdis_11gev_CJ15nlo.csv are referenced but not embedded. Parsers ignore wrong column counts and nonnumeric lines.
findings.impact: Full projections cannot be reproduced from this notebook alone; malformed numerical rows can disappear without a diagnostic.
findings.recommendation: Supply exact tables and hashes; use explicit schemas, row rejection logs, unit checks, and finite-value/rate validation.

findings.title: Labeling and legacy contour geometry need cleanup
findings.evidence: SHMS datasets are named HMS; the Lite legend can use nominal syst; PCA/max-extent approximates historical contour point sets.
findings.impact: Labels can misidentify datasets, and an enclosing display ellipse is not an inferred likelihood/covariance contour.
findings.recommendation: Correct labels and retain historical contour points with their original confidence convention and provenance.
